metadata.title: Controlled evaluation of typed multi-hop graph reasoning
metadata.research_question: How does the permitted typed path length affect recovery of held-out cause/consequence worksheet associations?

conditions.direct: Two-edge cause -> deviation -> consequence path only.
conditions.intermediate: Three-edge cause -> deviation -> effect -> consequence path only.
conditions.both: Both supported path patterns; shortest path selected per endpoint.

metadata.split_protocol: Same deterministic scenario-level split procedure as E1; all rows belonging to a scenario remain in one partition.
metadata.gold_label_semantics: Reconstructed worksheet row co-associations; not independently expert-validated physical causal ground truth.
metadata.path_selection_semantics: GraphReasoner.reason_all selects the shortest valid path per endpoint. Therefore, in both mode a direct path takes precedence over a three-edge path to the same endpoint.

direct.mode_definition: Two-edge cause -> deviation -> consequence path only.

summary.cost_note: Not captured by the current provider wrapper.
